title: Properties of materials
misconception: 1B-M1: gives a use (it cuts) when asked for a property
voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop (stand-in until the voice-over artist records)

pages.say: A property tells you what a material is like.

pages.board: hard or soft, rough or smooth
pages.say: Is it hard or soft? Is it rough or smooth?
Does it bend, or does it break?
Does water pass through it, or not?
A clay pot is hard. If it falls, it breaks.
A rubber band stretches, then springs back.
Water soaks into cloth. We say cloth absorbs water.
Be careful. Cutting is a use, not a property. Hard and sharp are properties.
Now it is your turn. Describe what a material is like.
